topic_ko: 후추는 입냄새 제거·의약적 효능·신분 과시라는 세 가지 이유로 과거에 '검은 금'이라 불릴 만큼 값진 사치품이었다

passage: Today a pepper grinder sits on almost every restaurant table without attracting attention.
Centuries ago the same spice was far beyond the reach of ordinary farmers.
In some regions landlords and tax collectors accepted pepper instead of coins.
That level of demand won it grand names such as "black gold" and "king of spices."
Three needs explain the price it commanded.
Long before toothbrushes existed, people chewed spices to cover unpleasant breath.
Pepper was also trusted as a cure that eased sleep, digestion, and sunburned skin.
Above all, a dish of pepper on a desk announced that its owner was wealthy and important.
choices: the modern trade routes that carry spices around the world
the reasons pepper was treated as a precious luxury in the past
the medical dangers of eating too much black pepper
how farmers learned to grow pepper in cooler climates
the difference in flavor between black and white pepper
theme.explanation_ko: 집세·세금 대납과 별명, 그리고 입냄새·의약·신분 과시라는 세 가지 이유가 모두 과거에 후추가 귀하게 여겨진 까닭을 설명하므로 ②가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ① 현대의 교역로는 언급되지 않는다. ③ 과다 섭취의 위험은 나오지 않는다. ④ 재배 방법은 다루지 않는다. ⑤ 후추의 종류별 맛 차이는 없다.

passage: Black pepper now flavors countless dishes and costs almost nothing.
In earlier centuries it was a rare luxury that peasants could never buy.
Rents and taxes were sometimes paid in peppercorns rather than money.
People called it "black gold" and "king of spices" for good reason.
It hid bad breath at a time when nobody owned a toothbrush.
It was believed to cure poor sleep, weak digestion, and sunburn.
And a bowl of it on a desk quietly displayed a family's wealth.
Pepper has always carried more meaning than its taste alone suggests.
choices: 후추는 향신료 가운데 가장 오래된 역사를 지니고 있다.
값비싼 향신료는 언제나 의학적 효능 때문에 거래되었다.
현대인은 향신료의 진짜 가치를 잊고 살아가고 있다.
후추는 맛뿐 아니라 위생·건강·신분이라는 가치를 함께 지녀 귀하게 여겨졌다.
과거의 세금 제도는 화폐보다 현물 납부에 의존했다.
gist.explanation_ko: 입냄새 제거(위생), 치료제(건강), 부와 지위의 상징(신분)이라는 세 이유가 후추의 가치를 설명하므로 ④가 요지이다.
gist.distractor_ko: ① 가장 오래된 향신료라는 주장은 없다. ② 의학적 효능은 세 이유 중 하나일 뿐이다. ③ 현대인을 비판하는 글이 아니다. ⑤ 현물 납부는 귀함을 보여 주는 사례일 뿐 요지가 아니다.

passage: A shake of pepper costs a few coins today, but it once cost a fortune.
Peasants in earlier centuries simply could not afford it.
Landlords in some regions took peppercorns in place of rent and tax.
Such hunger for the spice earned it the names "black gold" and "king of spices."
Before toothbrushes were invented, chewing spice was the way to sweeten breath.
Doctors of the day prescribed pepper for sleep, digestion, and sunburned skin.
A bowl of peppercorns on a desk told visitors exactly how rich the owner was.
In and out of the kitchen, pepper always offered more than it appeared to.
choices: The Spice That Once Bought Rent and Respect
Why Modern Cooking Uses Too Much Salt
A Guide to Growing Spices at Home
The Long Voyage of the First Spice Traders
title.explanation_ko: 집세 대납이라는 경제적 가치와 신분 과시라는 사회적 가치를 한 줄에 담은 ①이 글 전체를 아우르는 제목이다.
title.distractor_ko: ② 소금은 등장하지 않는다. ③ 재배 안내가 아니다. ④ 칫솔은 시대 배경으로만 언급된다. ⑤ 향신료 상인의 항해는 다루지 않는다.

passage: Black pepper is one of the most commonly used spices in the world today.
In the past, however, it was a rare and expensive luxury item that peasants could not afford.
In some parts of the world, people paid rents and taxes with black pepper.
It hid bad breath in an age without toothbrushes or toothpaste.
It was also believed to be a healing remedy for sleep, digestion, and sunburn.
Having pepper on one's desk was a symbol of wealth and dignity.
It is pretty obvious that black pepper has a lot more to offer than meets the eye.
Even now, the little black grain carries a history that its price no longer shows.
implication.underlined: a lot more to offer than meets the eye
choices: far greater value than its simple appearance suggests
a stronger taste than any other spice on the shelf
more health benefits than modern medicine can explain
a higher price than most shoppers are willing to pay
more varieties than an ordinary cook could name
implication.explanation_ko: 위생·의약·신분이라는 세 가지 의미를 함께 지녔다는 앞의 설명을 받는 표현이므로, 겉보기보다 훨씬 큰 가치를 지닌다는 ①이 적절하다.
implication.distractor_ko: ② 다른 향신료와의 맛 비교는 없다. ③ 현대 의학과의 대조는 나오지 않는다. ④ 오늘날의 가격은 오히려 싸다고 했다. ⑤ 품종의 다양성은 언급되지 않는다.

passage: Long ago, black pepper counted as a rare luxury far beyond a peasant's purse.
So desired was pepper that it earned fancy nicknames across the trading world.
First, in the centuries before toothbrushes and toothpaste were invented, spices were chewed to hide bad breath.
It was widely believed that pepper was a healing remedy that helped people sleep well, digest food, and relieve aches.
A third reason is that it elaborated one's social status and wealth for every visitor to see.
Have pepper on one's desk was a symbol of wealth and dignity.
Thus, not only did black pepper make food more delicious, but it also meant better health and greater wealth.
Considering all these points, nobody can doubt why pepper was priced like treasure.

underlines.text: helped people sleep well, digest food, and relieve
not only did black pepper make food more delicious

grammar.explanation_ko: 문장의 주어 자리에는 동사원형이 올 수 없으므로 동명사 Having 을 써야 한다. 뒤의 단수 동사 was 와도 호응한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 보어 So desired 가 문두로 나가면서 주어와 동사가 도치된 'so ~ that' 구문으로 옳다. ② help 는 목적격보어로 원형부정사를 취하고 sleep·digest·relieve 가 병렬을 이룬다. ④ 부정어구 not only 가 문두에 오면 주어와 조동사가 도치되므로 did ~ make 가 맞다. ⑤ 주절의 주어와 능동 관계인 분사구문으로 적절하다.

passage: Black pepper is recognized for its contribution to countless styles of world cuisine.
In the past, however, it was a rare and expensive luxury item that peasants could not afford.
In several regions, landlords and tax collectors accepted black pepper instead of coins.
Because it was so widely available, pepper earned fancy nicknames like "black gold" and "king of spices."
Before toothbrushes were invented, people used spices to reduce bad breath.
Pepper was believed to be a healing remedy that helped people digest food and relieve skin irritation.
Having pepper on one's desk quietly announced a family's wealth and dignity.
Considering all these, it is clear why pepper was such a highly valued commodity.
vocab.explanation_ko: 후추는 희귀하고 값비싸서 몹시 탐나는 것이었기에 화려한 별명을 얻었으므로, '널리 구할 수 있었다'는 widely available 은 '몹시 갈망되었다'는 뜻으로 바뀌어야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ① 서민이 '살 여유가 없었다'는 흐름에 맞다. ③ 입냄새를 '줄이기' 위해 향신료를 썼다는 의미로 적절하다. ④ 잠·소화·피부 자극에 도움이 되는 '치료제'라는 뜻으로 옳다. ⑤ 높이 평가받는 '물품'을 가리키므로 자연스럽다.

passage: Black pepper is ordinary today, but in earlier centuries it was anything but ordinary.
Peasants could not afford it, and landlords accepted it in place of rent and tax.
It even collected grand nicknames such as "black gold" and "king of spices."
One reason was hygiene, since spices covered bad breath before toothbrushes existed.
Another was medicine, because pepper was thought to aid sleep, digestion, and sunburned skin.
The third was display, as a bowl of peppercorns on a desk announced a family's wealth.
In short, what people were really buying with pepper was ______________________.
The flavor it added to a meal was almost the least of it.
choices: a safer way to store food through the long winter
cleanliness, health, and a place among the powerful
a substitute for the coins their government had stopped issuing
a trade secret that only wealthy merchants understood
protection against the diseases carried by travelers
blank.explanation_ko: 앞에 제시된 세 이유가 각각 위생(입냄새), 건강(치료제), 신분(부의 과시)이므로 이를 한 줄로 묶은 ②가 빈칸에 적절하다.
blank.distractor_ko: ① 식품 보존은 언급되지 않는다. ③ 화폐 발행 중단이라는 서술은 없다. ④ 상인의 영업 비밀은 나오지 않는다. ⑤ 전염병 예방은 본문의 세 이유에 없다.

irrelevant.intro: In the past, black pepper was a rare and expensive luxury item that ordinary peasants could not afford.
sentences: In some parts of the world, people even paid their rents and taxes with black pepper.
Before toothbrushes and toothpaste were invented, people used spices to reduce bad breath.
It was believed that pepper was a healing remedy that helped people sleep well and digest food.
Pepper plants grow best in warm, wet regions and take several years to bear fruit.
Having pepper on one's desk was a symbol of wealth and dignity.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: ④는 후추 나무의 재배 조건과 결실 시기에 관한 진술로, 후추가 왜 귀하게 여겨졌는지를 설명하는 흐름에서 벗어난다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: 나머지 네 문장은 후추의 귀함을 보여 주는 사례와 위생·의약·신분이라는 세 이유를 차례로 잇고 있어 모두 글의 흐름에 맞는다.

order.given: Black pepper is one of the most commonly used spices in the world today. In the past, however, it was a rare and expensive luxury item that peasants could not afford.

blocks.A: There are several reasons pepper was so highly regarded. First, before toothbrushes and toothpaste were invented, people used spices to reduce bad breath.
blocks.B: In some parts of the world, people even paid rents and taxes with it. So desired was pepper that it earned fancy nicknames like "black gold" and "king of spices."
blocks.C: Another reason was medical, since pepper was believed to help people sleep and digest food. The third reason is that it elaborated one's social status and wealth.

order.explanation_ko: 사치품이었다는 주어진 글 → 그 귀함의 증거인 집세·세금 대납과 별명(B) → 이유 예고와 첫째 이유(A) → 둘째·셋째 이유(C) 순서가 자연스럽다.
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 'Another reason'과 'The third reason'은 첫째 이유를 제시한 (A) 뒤에만 올 수 있고, (A)의 '여러 이유가 있다'는 예고는 후추가 얼마나 귀했는지를 보여 주는 (B) 다음에 오는 것이 자연스럽다.

insert.insert_sentence: There are several reasons black pepper was highly regarded in the past.

passage_marked.text: Today black pepper is one of the most commonly used spices in the world.
In the past, however, it was a rare luxury that peasants could not afford, and people even paid rents and taxes with it.
First, before toothbrushes and toothpaste were invented, people used spices to reduce bad breath.
Another reason was medical, for pepper was believed to help people sleep well and digest food.
The third reason is that having pepper on one's desk showed a person's social status and wealth.

insert.explanation_ko: '여러 이유가 있다'는 예고 문장은 후추가 귀했다는 사실을 제시한 뒤, 'First'로 시작하는 첫째 이유 앞에 와야 하므로 ②가 적절하다.
insert.distractor_ko: ① 자리는 아직 후추가 귀했다는 사실이 나오기 전이라 '높이 평가받은 이유'를 예고할 근거가 없다. ③④⑤ 뒤에 넣으면 이미 이유를 하나 이상 나열한 뒤에야 예고가 나오는 셈이라 순서가 뒤집힌다.

passage: Pepper is cheap and common on today's tables.
Centuries ago it was a luxury that peasants could never buy.
Some landlords and governments accepted it instead of rent and tax money.
It picked up the nicknames "black gold" and "king of spices."
In an age without toothbrushes, chewing spice covered bad breath.
Pepper was also trusted as a cure for poor sleep, weak digestion, and sunburn.
A bowl of peppercorns on a desk showed the owner's rank and riches.
Its worth lay far beyond the flavor it gave to a meal.
summary.summary_template: Pepper was once a costly __(A)__ because it freshened breath, was used as a medicine, and displayed the owner's social __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 서민이 살 수 없었던 값비싼 '사치품(luxury)'이었고, 세 번째 이유가 사회적 '지위(status)'의 과시였으므로 luxury–status 가 적절하다.
summary.distractor_ko: necessity(필수품)는 서민이 감당할 수 없었다는 서술과 어긋나고, duty(의무)·custom(관습)은 부와 지위를 드러냈다는 내용을 담지 못한다. medicine 은 세 이유 중 하나일 뿐이라 전체를 요약하지 못한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.question_ko: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오. <보기> was / that / desired / pepper / it / so / nicknames / earned / fancy
writing.ko_prompt: 후추는 몹시 탐나는 것이어서 화려한 별명을 얻었다.
writing.answer: So desired was pepper that it earned fancy nicknames.
writing.explanation_ko: 보어 desired 가 so 와 함께 문두로 나가면 주어와 동사가 도치되어 'So + 보어 + 동사 + 주어 + that ...' 어순이 된다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 책상 위에 후추를 두는 것은 부와 위엄의 상징이었다.
conditions: a symbol of wealth and dignity 를 반드시 포함할 것
writing.answer: Having pepper on one's desk was a symbol of wealth and dignity.
writing.explanation_ko: 동명사구가 주어이므로 단수 취급하여 동사는 was 를 쓴다.

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Thus, not only did black pepper make food more delicious, but it also meant better-smelling breath, better health, and greater wealth and elite position in society.
writing.answer: 따라서 후추는 음식을 더 맛있게 만들어 주었을 뿐만 아니라, 더 좋은 냄새가 나는 숨결과 더 나은 건강, 그리고 더 큰 부와 사회에서의 엘리트적 지위를 뜻하기도 했다.
writing.explanation_ko: 부정어구 not only 가 문두에 놓여 did + 주어 + 동사원형으로 도치된 문장이며, 'not only A but also B' 구문으로 두 내용을 연결한다.

writing.question: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
writing.question_ko: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: In the past, black pepper was a rare and expensive ___________ item, so ordinary peasants could not afford to buy it.
writing.explanation_ko: 서민이 살 수 없을 만큼 희귀하고 값비싼 물건이므로 '사치품'을 뜻하는 luxury item 이 알맞다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.question_ko: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.summary: People valued pepper because it reduced bad __(A)__, worked as a healing __(B)__, and showed a person's wealth and social status.
writing.explanation_ko: 첫 번째 이유는 'reduce bad breath', 두 번째 이유는 'a healing remedy'로 본문에 그대로 나온다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 이 글의 주제문을 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.question_ko: 다음 조건에 맞게 이 글의 주제문을 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 글의 주제를 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
conditions: luxury 와 social status 를 반드시 포함할 것
not only A but also B 구문을 사용할 것
writing.answer: Pepper was once a luxury not only because it improved food and health but also because it showed social status.
writing.explanation_ko: 맛·건강이라는 실용적 가치와 신분 과시라는 사회적 가치를 not only A but also B 로 묶으면 글의 주제가 한 문장에 담긴다.
